Proof in the paper: The TEM images further show the interplanar distance of 0.266 nm, which can be indexed to the (210) plane of NiSe2 [34], and the interplanar distance of 0.248 nm can be attributed to the (012) plane of FeSe2 [35], which confirms the successful construction of NiSe2/FeSe2 heterojunction. Moreover, the interlayer distance of 0.261 nm should be indexed into the (210) plane of CoSe2 [37] (Fig. S4d–f).
